title: A refused bare word suggests a note or late gate on a cancelled or superseded focus, which the core refuses
outcome: A refused bare word suggests a note or late gate on a cancelled or superseded focus, which the core refuses
acceptance: A test routes an actual cancelled or superseded focus (hold X, add Y, cancel Y, then a bare note and a bare gate) and checks that every offered command for the focus is one the core admits

The implicit-target refusal tells a completed focus apart from cancelled, superseded and proposed ones: it offers the explicit note and the late gate --work-ref only where the core admits them (completed work, or open work as each word allows), and show otherwise
docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md says which focus states get which command

completion.summary: A refused bare word offers only commands its focus admits: note or late gate only on completed work, show for cancelled or superseded work; the implicit-target conflict carries the focus lifecycle, and a test checks every offered command is admitted. Landed in 99c249e (bundle 8C-1).
